name: broad production health is independently supported
input: Give me a decision-useful production health assessment. Reconcile infra/ topology with fresh live evidence and identify every material unverified layer.

name: CI CD assessment is independently supported
input: Is CI/CD green for the current main revision? Verify the latest authoritative run and distinguish completed CI from approvals or deployment work still pending.

name: topology count is independently reconciled
input: How many production hosts do we actually expect and observe? Reconcile infra/ with runner identities without treating stale runner records as extra machines.

name: validation commands come from repository evidence
input: Report the primary validation commands for this repository. Cite the checked-in files that define them and do not modify anything.
